revenue.source: Apple 10-K filed 2025-10-31 (FYE 2025-09-27), consolidated statements of operations, total net sales

operating_income.source: Apple 10-K filed 2025-10-31, statements of operations, operating income

d_and_a.source: Apple 10-K filed 2025-10-31, cash flow statement, depreciation and amortization

capex.source: Apple 10-K filed 2025-10-31, cash flow statement, payments for acquisition of PP&E

revenue_growth.source: Assumption: FY2025 growth was 6.4%, FY2024 2.0%; fade from ~6% to 4% as services mix grows and hardware matures

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: FY2025 margin 32.0% (133,050/416,161), held flat; FY2024 31.5%

tax_rate.source: Assumption: approx. Apple recent effective tax rate mid-teens; slightly above to reflect global minimum tax pressure (not verified from filing)

capex_pct_revenue.source: Assumption: FY2025 capex 12,715/416,161 = 3.1%; 3-yr avg ~2.7%; use 3.0% given higher AI infrastructure spend

wacc.source: Assumption: risk-free ~4.2% + beta ~1.1 x ERP ~4.5-5%, minimal debt weight; not sourced from a data provider

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: roughly long-run nominal GDP/inflation, below WACC

net_debt.source: Apple 10-K FYE 2025-09-27: commercial paper 7,979 + current term debt 12,350 + non-current term debt 78,328 = 98,657, less cash 35,934 and marketable securities 96,486 (current 18,763 + non-current 77,723; total $132.4B per 10-K). Negative = net cash. Non-current securities value recalled, consistent with the $132.4B total.

diluted_shares.source: Apple 10-K filed 2025-10-31: weighted-average diluted shares 15,004,697 thousand, expressed in millions
